surfaces.help: Owner-produced PDFs in this app. Not Agno evidence.

surfaces.label: Privilege Check
surfaces.help: First-pass flags. Not a legal conclusion.

surfaces.help: Write the motion. Nothing here is filed until you say so.

surfaces.help: Starting structure for a paper you may later file.

surfaces.help: Mark what stays, what changes, and what is wrong.

surfaces.label: Analysis Queue

surfaces.label: Workflows
surfaces.help: Playbooks for recurring processes.

surfaces.help: Scheduled jobs. Enable, last-run, run now.

surfaces.label: Triggers
surfaces.help: Inbound notices. Process or dismiss.

surfaces.label: Audit Log
surfaces.help: What this workspace recorded.

surfaces.help: CourtListener, PACER-off, provider grid.

surfaces.label: Discovery
surfaces.help: Interrogatories, RFPs, RFAs.

surfaces.help: Working list. Evidence truth stays in Agno.

surfaces.label: Missing evidence
surfaces.help: Ask Agno to look. This app does not copy the evidence store.

surfaces.label: Tasks
surfaces.help: Things only you can do.

surfaces.label: Timeline
surfaces.help: What happened, in order.

surfaces.help: Routed agent traces.
